title: Dharma Talk 1 – Way of the Bodhisattva
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett emphasizes the importance of cultivating compassion in all its forms, including receiving it from others and practicing it towards ourselves. They encourage individuals to consider their own emotional needs and boundaries when offering or receiving compassion, and to approach this practice with self-awareness, honesty, and kindness. By embracing vulnerability and openness, we can develop a more authentic connection with ourselves and others, leading to a deeper understanding of what it means to truly care for and support one another.
